channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bryan Colangelo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bryan Colangelo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
Brett Brown on the report that Colangelo overruled others in the front office with his Fultz selection:

“That is untrue. There was a collaborative decision on Markelle, and we’re still happy that decision was made … Time will tell, but I’ve got belief in Markelle Fultz.”

Brett Brown on Markelle Fultz, Bryan Colangelo, Jun 16, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Adam Silver on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Adam Silver on Colangelo:

“The first thing we have to do here is determine what the actual facts are.”

Adam Silver on Bryan Colangelo, May 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Jahlil Okafor on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
“I tried to be professional; I will continue to be professional. But at some point, I have to defend myself, and this is my career. I’m not sure if [Colangelo] cares about that. I think that’s evident at this point.”

Jahlil Okafor on Bryan Colangelo, Nov 1, 2017. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Raymond Brothers on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
agent Raymond Brothers told ESPNon Tuesday night.

“My intention earlier was to let people know that he's been experiencing discomfort. We will continue to work with (Sixers general manager) Bryan Colangelo and the medical staff.”

Raymond Brothers on Bryan Colangelo, Oct 24, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on Bryan Colangelo:

“I feel the partnership that I can grow with Bryan is real.”

Brett Brown on Bryan Colangelo, Apr 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Tim Leiweke on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:Leiweke on Colangelo:

“I'm clearly not the best one to make this decision. That said, the board is leaning on me to make a recommendation.”

Tim Leiweke on Bryan Colangelo, Apr 26, 2013. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: Andrea Bargnani on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
Asked on the Sky Sports broadcast about Raptors GM Bryan Colangelo’s post-season assessment of his work, Bargnani replied:

“(Colangelo) had some unfortunate and not very courageous comments about me ... The facts are there for everybody to see and judge.”

Andrea Bargnani on Bryan Colangelo, May 24, 2011. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Chris Bosh on Bryan Colangelo
item.description:
“Comments like that, they don't bother me as a player. Professionally, I'm disappointed.[Colangelo and I] went through a lot together. He was the GM and we both tried our best to make that team better while I was there. We had many conversations, we went back and forth on e-mails, so just to hear that, it's disappointing. But at the end of the day, there's no reason to be upset. I know that I would have done anything to win.”

Chris Bosh on Bryan Colangelo, Aug 18, 2010. Source: SI.com.
